import re

def tokenize_arithmetic(expr: str) -> list[str]:
    # Remove whitespace
    expr = expr.replace(" ", "")
    
    # Regular expression to match tokens
    token_pattern = re.compile(r'\d+|-?\d+|\+|\-|\*|\/|\%|\(|\)')
    
    # Find all tokens using the regular expression
    tokens = token_pattern.findall(expr)
    
    return tokens
